mechanism: Torsemide causes electrolyte depletion and hypotension, while chlorpromazine has anticholinergic and alpha-blocking properties that can potentiate hypotension and increase risk of arrhythmias, particularly with hypokalemia.
action: Monitor blood pressure, electrolytes (especially potassium), and cardiac function; consider potassium supplementation and regular ECG monitoring; use lowest effective doses of both agents.
